title: 9. Sliding Window Maximum
description:
You are given an array of integers `nums`, there is a sliding window of size `k` which is moving from the very left of the array to the very right. You can only see the `k` numbers in the window. Each time the sliding window moves right by one position.

Return the max sliding window.
constraints:
• 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5
• 1 <= k <= len(nums)
• Optimal Time: O(N) | Space: O(K)
explanation: A monotonic deque stores indices with values in strictly decreasing order. The maximum value for the current window is always at `dq[0]`. Elements smaller than the incoming number are popped from the back. Each element is added and removed at most once, yielding O(N) linear time.
